summary: Reproduce native reuse on pinned NL DSL consumer code

delivery.outcome: Deliver a repeatable Sorust-owned practical developer pilot using unmodified pinned NL DSL source, installed-wheel and standalone binary parity, explicit resource sidecar, shared prebuilt Rust cdylib/rlib consumers, and bounded honest measurements. Independently merge tool and canonical standard v17, preserve/release checkout.
nonGoals: Migrate or modify consumer repositories, copy their implementation into tracked Sorust source, run production traffic, networks, LLM/API/service effects.
Change Sorust runtime/backend/kernel/ABI/dependencies/platform coverage or auto-export unmanifested data.
Claim arbitrary Python is faster, Unicode str.split compatibility, complete consumer conformance or general cross-repository architecture conclusions; release/deploy/protected policy changes.

architecture.decision: A stdlib developer script reads fixed consumer files via exact40hex Git commit into new private checkout-bound scratch, builds original package initializer/module with installed Sorust backend and unchanged Rust source snapshot, creates a minimal runtime without Sorust/Cython/toolchain and tests source, installed compiled and exported compiled modes in separate processes. Run pinned conformance functions, compare normalized results, 7 warmed timing series and profiles. Export sidecar failure is demonstrated then consumer resource is copied with explicit pinned hash. All modes share one prebuilt exported Rust .so; an independent Rust client links existing .rlib with exact toolchain. Include encoding/packing in FFI timing and report Unicode whitespace differences instead of substituting semantics.
interfaceChanges: Developer-only pilot CLI; runtime API unchanged
architecture.rollback: Protected reviewed revert; preserve original local artifacts, input/reuse/benchmark receipts and all ignored checkout data.

validation.evidence: New scratch, revision/wheel/resource confinement validation; unchanged consumer files, real sdist/wheel and source/native/export parity; actual pinned conformance function results per mode; resource limitation and Unicode mismatch explicit; prebuilt shared Rust .so and .rlib reuse proven.

All suites and final artifacts/install/export/hash smoke pass. Pilot reports pinned code/input/artifact hashes, environment, corpus,7 warmed timing samples, encoding/packing boundaries and profile; no speed threshold or production claim. Canonical v17 documents local tool and exact evidence.

Canonical metadata/index/tracking and pinned own Docs check; local and required remote gates, frozen exact-head independent approval/merge, postmerge smoke, released lease and preserved owned checkout cleanup/audit.
